name: Saint Seraphina
source:
Race: Dragon

Saint Seraphina is Valanche's most precious treasure and also its protector. While the Keepers would prefer that she remains a figurehead, Seraph disagrees. In her free time the Saint runs guided tours that show off the city's hidden gems and hot spots.
